declared: 2026-10-30, before any score on these sources was computed
purpose: One independent evaluation of the frozen OOF DGA candidate to decide runtime promotion. Replaces the unmaterialized reserved set of docs/DGA_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md with the sources actually available; the four gates are unchanged.

candidate.frozen: No refit, no retune, no second candidate, no re-run after seeing results.

sources.benign_dns: data/raw/ait-session-join-20261021/dnsmasq-original.log: real client DNS questions of the AIT testbed, excluding the controlled exfiltration namespace kennedy-mendoza.info (17,693 questions from one host); not used for training or design

family_exclusion.rule: A family is excluded if its name, lower-cased and stripped of non-alphanumeric characters, starts with any development root below: an algorithm and its variants cannot be split between development and evaluation.

overlap_exclusion: Any first label present in the development lists (data/raw/umudga and data/raw/umudga-expanded, legitimate and DGA) or in the CIC DNS benign_1/benign_2 captures is dropped from every evaluation set.

sampling.reservoir: uniform reservoir sampling (Algorithm R) in file order

scoring: Candidate score on the canonical first label (ml.dga.domain_label); a name the label function rejects (for example internationalized names) cannot be scored and counts as a MISS for positives and as NOT a false positive for benign.

metrics.recall: micro over all sampled unseen-family domains (macro and per-family reported)
metrics.domain_fpr: false positives / scored benign domains from the T25 benign sample
metrics.benign_dns_fpr: false positives / unique eligible first labels of the AIT benign DNS names

decision: Promote the candidate to runtime only if ALL four gates pass and the minimum counts hold. Any failure leaves it disabled, with the failure analysis recorded; the evaluation is not repeated.
